summary: Linear search over up to three stride-2 championship score thresholds starting at this+0x164 (this[89]). For each entry it tests whether the threshold value is greater than the player score at *this + 0x403C and lower than the total-race-laps global dword_8ACF8C; the first qualifying entry is returned via this[2*v2+89]. Returns -1 when no entry qualifies or the 3-entry cap is reached. Called by ShortComputation_c8a0 (0049C8A0).

local_names.this: championship/session object owning the threshold table
local_names.v2: loop counter over the stride-2 threshold entries
local_names.v3: walking pointer into the threshold array starting at this+0x164

operations.description: Initializes result to -1, the loop counter to 0, and the walking pointer to the first entry at this+0x164 (this[89])
Iterates while the counter is below this[88] (the entry count at this+0x160), with a hard cap of 3 iterations and a stride of 2 dwords per entry
